tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Diagnose a domain's email setup: SPF (incl. the 10 DNS-lookup limit), DKIM keys, DMARC policy, MX and mail provider, inbound spam-filter gateway, MTA-STS/TLS-RPT, and Spamhaus/SpamCop/Barracuda blocklists. Returns a grade A–F, a status per check, and the exact DNS TXT records to fix each problem, wo

tools.name: get_dns_fixes
tools.description: Return every recommended email DNS fix for a domain as a BIND zone file, each record marked ADD or REPLACE. Use it to apply fixes through a DNS provider's zone import or API (Cloudflare, Route 53, Google Cloud DNS, Azure DNS).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_domain, get_dns_fixes · Private data: check_domain, get_dns_fixes · Public sink: check_domain, get_dns_fixes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_domain, get_dns_fixes · Private data: check_domain, get_dns_fixes · Public sink: check_domain, get_dns_fixes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
